scope: Static, AI-assisted review of the complete two-file diff plus loader command construction, path validation and test setup at the pinned head. Head file blobs verified; nothing executed, including tests and fixture scripts.
findings: run_loader creates a new POSIX session only for the Wine path. On timeout or KeyboardInterrupt, SIGKILL targets that spawned process group; it does not accept a caller-supplied process ID or use a global process-name kill.

Session.run keeps argument-list subprocess invocation, the selected local loader/Wine paths, overlay directory and log streams. No shell interpolation, remote fetch, credential access or persistence was added.

The new test creates its Python launcher, lock file and logs under TemporaryDirectory, then checks lock release after timeout. Read the fixture source without executing it. No hidden/bidi characters or review instructions found.
